A fix for the new-event form in 1.0.0.

![OmaCal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.0.1/preview.png)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88d5ff29-20e9-4e64-958d-b75dc3dade17

The launch video, also [in 1080p60](https://github.com/crmne/omacal/releases/download/v1.0.1/omacal-launch-1080p60.mp4).

## Fixed

- **New events start clean again.** In 1.0.0, opening the form (the panel's +, `N`, a double-clicked day, or Alt+Shift+Space) did not reset the day and times or put the cursor in the title, because one of the form's fields shared its name with the function that fills it in. Found by the screenshot renderer, which now fails on any script error in the plugin.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.

OmaCal is an independent project, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by HEY or 37signals.
